no_adcom_quote.quote: This application was not referred to ODAC because outside expertise was not necessary as there were no controversial issues that would benefit from advisory committee discussion. The clinical study design was acceptable and the application did not raise significant safety or efficacy issues in the intended population.

summary: No advisory committee meeting was convened for SYLVANT (siltuximab, BLA125496). The Office Director memo states the application was not referred to ODAC because there were no controversial issues warranting advisory committee discussion, and the Summary Review, Cross-Discipline Team Leader review, and Medical Review all confirm no Advisory Committee meeting was held. Because no AdComm occurred, there are no committee-driven linkages to the approval.
